images.name: light
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game background 2000x667. Reference 1 spacecraft cockpit provides materials and palette: ivory armor panels, navy/plum metal, cyan and magenta instrument lights. Reference 2 Kyoto veranda supplies exact framing, camera and spatial depth. Transform cramped cockpit into spacious spacecraft command/observation deck with Kyoto-like composition. Seated eye height horizon 48 percent from bottom, cylindrical panoramic feel without fisheye bulge. Overhead structural ribs and floor panel seams converge toward centre. Two substantial ivory/navy support posts flank a broad central opening; low sleek rails at deck edge with broad central gap. Foreground is empty navy-metal deck floor, no dashboard, table or props across front of player.
Far away 10-15m in centre stands a small spacecraft communications/mail dispatch pedestal with a simple glowing cyan envelope pictogram and rectangular dark delivery slot just below horizon. It is the modest distant focal point, not a big foreground object. Behind it a vast panoramic observation window, with smaller windows down sides. ALL window interiors must be completely flat solid chroma green #00FF00 for compositing the existing space background later: NO stars, planets, nebulae, gradients, reflections or tint on green. Crisp window boundaries. Green color nowhere else.
Lateral command aisles recede into depth like Kyoto side corridors, richly furnished: angled instrument consoles, compact radar screens with abstract graphics, flight seats tucked at outer stations, equipment racks, cable conduits, storage cases, charging docks and small service trolleys. Different coherent groups left/right, busy at edges and midground; broad central approach stays empty. No tall props obstruct windows or central pedestal. Light state: bright cool white/cyan interior lighting, restrained magenta accents, gentle highlights, softly faceted painterly 3D game style matching previous scenes. No people, weapons, readable text, logo, HUD overlays, vignette. Single full-bleed panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Edit exact provided spacecraft command deck into DARK lighting state. Preserve all geometry, framing, camera, distant central mail pedestal, every console chair trolley rack case railing pillar and floor seam in same place. ONLY change interior lighting: bright overhead white lighting off, deep navy plum shadows; soft cyan instrument screens, magenta status accents and subtle cyan floor/rail lights illuminate interior. Central envelope pedestal glows cyan as clear focus. Dim moody after-hours spaceship, side equipment readable in reflected light, empty foreground. CRITICAL all window interiors remain EXACTLY bright flat solid chroma green #00FF00 unchanged in brightness, no shading, reflections, stars, scenery or gradients: these are compositing masks, not actual light sources. No green spill on interior. Same painterly faceted 3D game style, 3:1 panorama 2000x667. No new props, people, weapons, text, UI or vignette.
